headline: Amazon knocks $150 off Pixel 11 phones, with up to $200 in gift cards
summary: Amazon is offering significant discounts on Google Pixel 11 phones. Save $150 instantly using a special coupon code at checkout. Potential for an additional $200 in gift cards with your purchase.

headline: Being a mom is hard — the heat is making it harder
summary: High temperatures are posing challenges for families in Southern California. Parents find it difficult to manage daily activities with young children due to heat stress. The article touches on the broader impact of climate on personal life.

headline: The Switch 2’s $50 price increase is happening next week
summary: Nintendo Switch 2 will see a $50 price hike starting September 1st. The base 256GB model will increase from $449.99 to $499.99. This is a final reminder before the price adjustment takes effect next week.

headline: Apple Maps has ads now
summary: Advertisements have begun appearing within Apple Maps. Businesses can now pay for prominent placement in search results and suggestions. This follows Apple's March announcement about integrating ads into the mapping service.

headline: Rockstar Games Doubled in Size for GTA 6, Hired Real World Professionals for Fashion, Vehicles, and More
summary: Rockstar Games significantly expanded its team for Grand Theft Auto 6 development. Employee headcount for GTA 6 has reportedly doubled. Real-world experts were brought in for authenticity in fashion, vehicles, and other game elements.

headline: The SteelSeries 25th Anniversary Sale Gifts You Free Gear When You Buy One of Its Best Gaming Headsets
summary: SteelSeries is celebrating its 25th anniversary with a special sale. Receive free gaming gear when purchasing select premium headsets. Customers can save up to $110 during this limited-time promotion.

headline: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 for Switch 2 Is Up for Preorder
summary: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is now available for preorder on Nintendo Switch 2. Physical copies are distributed as a download code in a box, not a cartridge. Secure your copy of the highly anticipated shooter for the new Switch console.

headline: The Duskbloods Feels Like a Nintendo Party Game in a Bloody Wrapper
summary: "The Duskbloods" blends a grotesque FromSoftware-style exterior with familiar gameplay. Despite its dark aesthetics, the game plays like a classic multiplayer Nintendo title. It offers a surprisingly accessible party game experience hidden beneath a bloody wrapper.

headline: Video shows scale of flash flood hitting Nepal-Tibet border
summary: New video footage reveals the immense scale of a flash flood. The devastating natural disaster occurred along the Nepal-Tibet border. The BBC edited the video due to its distressing content.

headline: Meta to pay up to $18bn to settle claims its platforms harm children
summary: Meta faces a settlement of up to $18 billion over claims its platforms harm children. The agreement was reached during a federal court trial in California. US states brought the claims against the social media giant.

headline: Rocky Horror star Tim Curry dies at 80
summary: Beloved actor Tim Curry has passed away at the age of 80. Curry was famously known for his iconic role as Frank-N-Furter. He starred in the cult classic film, The Rocky Horror Picture Show.

headline: Murder arrests after fire kills two including child near Middlesbrough
summary: Multiple arrests have been made in connection with a fatal fire. The blaze near Middlesbrough claimed the lives of two individuals, including a child. Police are investigating potential links to wider organised crime.
